title: Short latency-critical requests behind long ones
description: 20% of requests are short and latency-critical; the server marks them HIGH with a 60 us deadline. The other 80% are about ten times longer and stay NORMAL. Under FIFO a short request that arrives behind long ones waits for them, so its tail latency is set by the long requests. This is the simplest case where a priority hint should help.
changed_from_previous: w0 plus a second, short, HIGH request kind.
notes: Service times in iterations of stridedmem:1024:7; gen 0 calibrates them in microseconds. A first single run showed short p99 89 us (fifo) vs 49 us (prio) at 400k req/s.
